backdrop.status: RULED - E14 Ruling 7 (hue family blue-violet; house form, one colour term)
backdrop.why: Derived per subject (the S3 method) and the WORD chosen at the ruling, never by the metric: the top four families tie at 0.3549 to four decimals, all bound by GOLD's blue-channel gap, so the tie is gold evidence, not steel evidence (the 8a mechanism, sharper). Neutral white - the metric's co-optimum - is disqualified by the fixture's own pre-registered constraint: S-steel's backdrop cannot be ANY grey, and white is the L* 100 end of the achromatic axis; the sensitivity table is the teeth (at L1 L* 94, where worn steel's speculars live under harsh directional light, white scores 0.078 against the key's 0.06 cut). Blue-violet holds the largest hue margin to every occupied material (>=123 deg vs gold 83.5 / oxblood 25.4 / garnet 24.3, where cyan holds 116.5 and magenta 55), carries the most chroma at the tabled optimum (C* 21.4 - the channel achromatic steel cannot erase at any lightness), was the fixture's pre-registered expectation CHECKED and confirmed (five of seven bands unoccupied; L1/L2 below the floor occupy none), and the route has painted the family cleanly once (the beast's accepted pair). Deliberately NOT 'lavender-grey': this subject's whole risk is grey, so the word must not contain it. The beast's ruled value scores worst-of-four here (0.1255, bound by L1) - the per-subject law's third vindication. THE 15i CHECK RIDES WITH THE PAIR: L1's realised lightness AND chroma measured (cool-cast materialisation above the C* 5 floor inside blue-violet is the named risk - a finding for the bands derivation, not a re-choice of the word), and the realised backdrop's L*/C* measured against the estimate (214,214,255 / L* 86.9 / C* 21.4, riding in backdrop/backdrop.json). The pair supersedes the estimate the moment it exists. REALISED AT THE PAIR (E14 Ruling 14): hue ~305 on all three artifacts - the MAGENTA band, five degrees outside blue-violet, holding 78-79 deg to the wine family rather than the credited >=123 (Ruling 7's ground corrected in place); darker and more saturated than the triple (L* 55.6-72.2, C* 32.6-37.1; 16.6 L* seed span - the per-image key is unaffected by construction); separation 0.51-0.67 against the key's 0.06 cut (8-11x) with steel arriving DARK (L* 21-24), the mechanism inverted from the sensitivity table's feared direction. THE WORD STANDS on the measured separation; L1's floor-marginal cool cast (C* 5.39 on the re-roll, hue ~295) is routed to the palette-bands derivation per Ruling 7b, and the bands derive from REALISED values, never the estimates file.
